limits: The floor applies only to the files a ticket's slices name under packages/core/src, not to the whole package, so code a slice does not name is held to no mutation score until a later ticket names it.

This ticket writes no money property and no product code under packages/core/src; its own mutation figure is null and the sprint report shows a dash. The properties belong to the tickets that write each money function (SEEN-016 to SEEN-020, SEEN-033).

The under-ten-minutes figure is check 48 of attempt 4 (32 seconds cold, 29 seconds warm) on a src holding one mutable file; it shows the step is fast on today's src, not on a much larger one, and no record re-measures the selection changes of attempts 5 to 10 in CI.
CI does not run test:fixtures, so the seeded-bug fixture of criterion 5 is proven by RED 40 and GREEN 41 and the qa check (record 156), not on every pull request.
The floor starts at 70 and is raised only by a human-reviewed thresholds.toml diff; this ticket does not raise it.

Coverage is measured on @seen/core's vitest suite, not on harness/, so the unchanged 100 percent says nothing about the harness change. What covers it is the harness suite, 1702 tests at regression 151 and again at qa 156.
